# Overview

EpiSegDiff estimates a replicate-aware differential-effect track
(\(\hat\beta_i\) or \(Z_i\)) and segments that track. It does not
segment raw coverage. BH q-values after adaptive discovery are not
claimed to be guaranteed region-level FDR.

```{r setup}
library(EpiSegDiff)
cfg <- default_config()
cfg$differential$score
cfg$segmentation$loss
```

See `docs/statistical_model.md` and `config/example.yaml`.
